papers.title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
papers.summary: MoveBench introduces a specialized benchmark for evaluating large language models on sports and health coaching, emphasizing safety, scientific validity, and personalization across multiple-choice and open-ended tasks.

papers.title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
papers.summary: A world model predicts machine learning program outcomes to enable affordable test-time scaling for AI research agents, improving performance with fewer real executions.

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
papers.summary: Just Action Model decouples backbone initialization, future observation objectives, and inference machinery to improve robot control with foresight training and reduced computation.

papers.title: Timestral
papers.summary: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.

papers.title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
papers.summary: GeoUG improves spatial reasoning by combining depth and multi-view generation with adaptive geometric verification during inference.
